description: Read the agent's current settings: rollout, handoff, followup and ai_audience. Known limitation: this returns an ARRAY with one entry per channel, not a single object. Read the entry whose `channel` you care about (usually "whatsapp") rather than treating the response as an object.

agent_id.description: Optional - restrict the read to one agent.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_get_agent_settings
title: Read agent settings
